I'm a big fan of D cell products, and this one fits that mold.

Grab four rechargeable batteries ( don't leave in the radio if it's rarely used) and you're good to go.

PRO
-Headphone 3.5mm out
-Good antenna for AM
-Short wave - not sure how much use these days
-Nonproprietary AC cable for optional power
-Loud enough

CON
-No USB charge option (D cell charger needed)
-Somewhat hard to tune on FM especially - teeny turns of the dial will change the station
-No station memory
-Audio quality is predictable; i.e., ho-hum

NOTE I have tried solar powered radios and they don't cut it unless maybe you're in Arizona. At least for this size.
